title: A Long Walk to the Waterfall
text:
Maria and her friend Lucas wanted to see a big waterfall in the forest. They started to walk early in the morning, with water, bread and a map. The path was steep, so they stopped many times to rest.

After three hours, they heard a loud sound. They arrived at the waterfall and took many photos. Lucas was very tired, but he said the walk was worth it.

questions.text: What did Maria and Lucas want to see?
options: A big waterfall in the forest

questions.text: What did they do after they arrived at the waterfall?
Why did they stop many times on the path?
options: The path was steep and they needed to rest
They were waiting for a bus

questions.text: How did Lucas feel about the walk at the end?
options: He thought the walk was worth it
He wanted to leave at once
He did not want to see the waterfall

rising or falling very quickly, not gently
to stop working or moving in order to get your strength back

paragraph_translations: Maria e o amigo dela, Lucas, queriam ver uma cachoeira grande na floresta. Eles começaram a caminhar cedo, com água, pão e um mapa. O caminho era íngreme, então pararam muitas vezes para descansar.
Depois de três horas, ouviram um barulho forte. Chegaram à cachoeira e tiraram muitas fotos. Lucas estava muito cansado, mas disse que a caminhada tinha valido a pena.
